steps.whatIf:
import io

def simulate_chunked_stream():
    chunks = [f'{{"tick": {i}}}' for i in range(100)]
    output_buffer = io.StringIO()
    for c in chunks:
        hex_len = f"{len(c):x}"
        output_buffer.write(f"{hex_len}\r\n{c}\r\n")
    output_buffer.write("0\r\n\r\n")
    return output_buffer.getvalue()

result = simulate_chunked_stream()
print("=== HTTP CHUNKED ENCODING SIMULATION ===")
print(f"Total Streamed Ticks: 100")
print(f"Raw Encoded Stream Length: {len(result)} bytes")
print(f"Stream Verified: {result.endswith('0\r\n\r\n')}")
print("Chunked transport successfully framed.")
